name: buildermesh
description: buildermesh: a NATS mesh for coordinating coding agents, and the skills its nodes follow.

plugins.name: buildermesh
plugins.description: The operator skills (work: one way in for whatever the operator brings about a repo, from a question or a fix made in the chat to a round, the picks it starts as leads, what's building and a release; scaffold; ponytail-review, ponytail's review of a change; sync and prune across boxes) and the lead, executor, fix, ideate-engineer and ideate-ux skills for nodes on a buildermesh mesh: delegation shape, checkpoints, branch hand-back, the verified line and the proposal round, over the bmesh CLI; and a session hook that says which box a session runs on (bmesh hosts --here) and when this box's bmesh is behind main (bmesh update --notice).
